unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning a compact LLM on curated, evidence-based domain-specific Q&A data to improve response quality for smoking cessation dialogues, evaluated with BLEU, ROUGE-L, and BERTScore against the base model

screen.reason: The study develops a curated smoking cessation Q&A dataset, fine-tunes ChatGPT-4o-mini, and benchmarks it against the base model using automated NLP metrics (BLEU, ROUGE-L, BERTScore). It tests model fine-tuning rather than an operational deployment practice or guardrail.
